02

Give every format the same space.

Same complete source record; lossless round trips using the Python runner.
FormatMessage bytesFields restoredWithin budget?

A byte is not a model token. No record is truncated to make it fit. All required decoder programs are assumed available; their code size is excluded for all formats. Gzip includes its base64 and message-prefix overhead. LAMAGUE L1 uses no dictionary.

Check the five human questions
These answers were supplied by the author. This page has not tested whether another person or model reaches them.
See the encoded messages

          
What this demonstration establishes
It measures exact preservation of one authored record in three formats and compares twelve deliberately constructed controls. The full-record comparison works equally on JSON and decoded LAMAGUE.
    Run this on your own machine
    From the Framework source checkout, with Python 3.10 or newer:
    python3 examples/meaning_handover/demo.py
    Download the reference and a changed handover above, then compare them locally:
    python3 examples/meaning_handover/demo.py \
  --reference handover-reference.json \
  --candidate handover-candidate.json
    Exit 0 means exact record equality, 1 means a changed record, and 2 means malformed input. Nothing is executed on the basis of the result.

    Make your next handover.
    
        
    Write what you mean, then review the record before sharing it with your next AI session or collaborator. This form arranges your words; it does not interpret them or approve an action. Your draft stays in this page until you choose a download. There is no autosave.

    Inspect the structured record
    
          
    The record contains your declarations. Blank optional fields mean no information was provided; they do not prove that no uncertainty, objection or affected person exists. This is the packet branch of LAMAGUE, exported as JSON. No L1 encoding or language-understanding comparison is performed here.

    The next test belongs to real work.
    Can someone outside this project hand over a task with fewer corrections, at a fixed message budget? The next study needs independently written source tasks, a strong ordinary summary, structured JSON, LAMAGUE, and independent assessors who do not know which arm produced each answer.
    We will need to count omissions, invented facts, mistaken permission and the time spent repairing them. Using the builder or submitting feedback is a usability observation, not that controlled comparison.
